# Staged review summary

Source: execplan-implementation-native (workspace_driver).
Remote mutations: none.

## Result
No blocking findings were produced by the staged review workflow.
6 non-blocking finding(s) remain for reviewer judgment.
9 risk/coverage/review note(s) were retained separately from findings.

## Blockers
- None.

## Non-blocking findings
- [high/security] SelfCI now lets the candidate change the validation gate it must pass (.config/selfci/ci.yaml; evidence=static)
- [high/testing] No retained validation evidence was supplied for the refactor (artifacts/review/prepare_review/validation-status.v1.json; evidence=static)
- [high/testing] Review-artifact path coverage missed malformed bundle paths (test/review_artifacts_test.gleam; evidence=static)
- [medium/correctness] Generated ExecPlan fallback commands point to a removed helper path (workflows/dogfood/scripts/scherzo-execplan-html; evidence=static)
- [medium/security] Final validation does not scrub the new workflow bundle environment (workflows/dogfood/scripts/scherzo-implementation; evidence=static)
- [medium/maintainability] ExecPlan HTML output still points consumers at the removed root helper path (workflows/dogfood/scripts/scherzo-execplan-html; evidence=static)

## Risk / coverage / review notes
- [risk_note/correctness] Final validation environment does not scrub the newly introduced workflow bundle variable. (workflows/dogfood/scripts/scherzo-implementation)
- [risk_note/security] Packaged dogfood workflows may copy local-only bundle files into the Nix output. (nix/scherzo-dogfood-workflows.nix)
- [risk_note/artifact_contract] Retained source metadata includes malformed brace-derived paths. (artifacts/review/prepare_review/source-metadata.v1.json)
- [coverage_note/testing] No validation status was supplied with the review artifacts. (artifacts/review/prepare_review/validation-status.v1.json)
- [coverage_note/testing] The retained validation status artifact does not report test/build results. (artifacts/review/prepare_review/validation-status.v1.json)
- [follow_up_test/testing] Add a direct assertion for `SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR` in the command-validator env probe test (test/structured_output_command_validator_test.gleam)
- [review_note/maintainability] Bundle-dir lookup logic is now duplicated across two Gleam modules. (src/scherzo/workflow_bundle.gleam)
- [review_note/maintainability] Workflow YAML now repeats the same bundle bootstrap shell prologue in many steps. (workflows/dogfood/implementation.yaml)
- ... 1 additional note(s) omitted; see JSON artifact.

## Lane health
- correctness: succeeded with 1 finding(s) and 3 note(s).
- test-quality: succeeded with 2 finding(s) and 1 note(s).
- idioms-maintainability: succeeded with 1 finding(s) and 2 note(s).
- security-performance: succeeded with 2 finding(s) and 3 note(s).

## Counts
- Total findings: 6
- Blocking findings: 0
- Non-blocking findings: 6

non_blocking_findings.details:
Previously the SelfCI command executed the base checkout's CI script, so a candidate could not simply remove required validation steps. The new ci.yaml executes $SELFCI_CANDIDATE_DIR/.config/selfci/ci.sh, and scherzo-implementation adds a bootstrap path that validates with @ as the SelfCI config base when this transition is detected. Once this lands, any candidate can make .config/selfci/ci.sh exit successfully or omit expensive/security-relevant gates, and the final SelfCI result can still pass unless a separate protected contract verifies the gate.

Downgraded during native lane normalization because deterministic evidence was missing.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Keep a base-owned SelfCI entrypoint for protected gates, or add a base-owned contract that fails if the candidate CI script removes or rewrites required validation steps. If candidate CI changes must be tested, run them in addition to—not instead of—the protected gate.
non_blocking_findings.summary: SelfCI now lets the candidate change the validation gate it must pass

non_blocking_findings.details:
For a change that rewires workflow loading, helper resolution, and artifact generation, the absence of retained validation results is a blocking test-quality gap: later reviewers cannot tell which checks actually passed.

Downgraded during native lane normalization because deterministic evidence was missing.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Re-run artifact preparation with real validation status attached, or retain the relevant format/test/lint/package/workflow-portability results in the validation-status artifact.
non_blocking_findings.summary: No retained validation evidence was supplied for the refactor

non_blocking_findings.details:
This is a concrete test-quality gap: the relocation touched review artifact generation heavily, yet the added assertions stop short of verifying the path contract that downstream lanes depend on for context snapshots and changed-path reasoning.

Downgraded during native lane normalization because deterministic evidence was missing.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Extend review-artifact tests to assert that every serialized path in source metadata and changed-files artifacts is normalized, repository-relative, and free of malformed bundle-move leftovers before accepting the refactor.
non_blocking_findings.summary: Review-artifact path coverage missed malformed bundle paths

non_blocking_findings.details:
The moved helper now lives under workflows/dogfood/scripts and is surfaced as .scherzo/workflows/scripts. However section_fallback_command, build_brief fallback_commands, missing-section diagnostics, and the rendered HTML hint still hard-code scripts/scherzo-execplan-html. When a verifier follows a generated brief's fallback to read a truncated or missing section, the command fails in the candidate checkout because scripts/scherzo-execplan-html no longer exists.

Downgraded during native lane normalization because deterministic evidence was missing.

Downgraded during synthesis because correctness blockers require verified executable evidence.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Centralize the displayed ExecPlan HTML helper command and emit a bundle-local path, e.g. a SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR fallback snippet or .scherzo/workflows/scripts/scherzo-execplan-html. Add a renderer/brief regression test asserting generated fallback commands resolve after the bundle move and no longer mention the removed root scripts path.
non_blocking_findings.summary: Generated ExecPlan fallback commands point to a removed helper path

non_blocking_findings.details:
The change exports SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR to workflow command environments, and dogfood workflow commands now prefer that variable before falling back to the configured workflow directory. validate_command intentionally calls validation_env() before running SelfCI to prevent workflow-run scoped settings from leaking into nested helper invocations, but validation_env() removes SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_ID and related values while leaving SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR intact. That can mask bundle-resolution and helper-script regressions during the publish validation gate.

Downgraded during native lane normalization because deterministic evidence was missing.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Add SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR to validation_env()'s scrub list and add a regression test that sets an inherited bogus bundle path before final validation, then proves nested SelfCI/helper invocations resolve through the candidate checkout or explicit fixture instead.
non_blocking_findings.summary: Final validation does not scrub the new workflow bundle environment

non_blocking_findings.details:
The helper now lives inside the workflow bundle, and `docs/GETTING_STARTED.md` explicitly documents consuming that bundle via `.scherzo/workflows`. However the helper's own generated guidance still hardcodes the old source-tree path, and the updated renderer tests preserve those stale strings instead of catching the mismatch.

Downgraded during native lane normalization because deterministic evidence was missing.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Teach `workflows/dogfood/scripts/scherzo-execplan-html` to emit bundle-local commands (for example `.scherzo/workflows/scripts/scherzo-execplan-html ...`, or another path that exists in packaged consumers), then update the renderer tests to assert the new guidance.
non_blocking_findings.summary: ExecPlan HTML output still points consumers at the removed root helper path

review_notes.details: scherzo-implementation validation_env removes many workflow-run-scoped SCHERZO_* variables before invoking SelfCI, but the newly exported SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR is not in that scrub list. That can let nested tests and helper fixtures inherit the outer workflow bundle path, masking fallback behavior or coupling validation to the enclosing workflow run.
review_notes.suggested_action: Add SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR to validation_env's scrub list and include a regression assertion with the other workflow-context cleanup tests.
review_notes.summary: Final validation environment does not scrub the newly introduced workflow bundle variable.

review_notes.details: The new package copies workflows/dogfood wholesale, while the shared source filter only excludes test/tmp. The repo now documents local workflow variants and nested .scherzo state under workflows/dogfood as ignored; local path builds should ensure those files cannot be copied into a world-readable/store-distributed workflow bundle.
review_notes.suggested_action: Whitelist packaged bundle paths or explicitly exclude local YAML, nested .scherzo state, and other ignored/local-only files before copying into the Nix output.
review_notes.summary: Packaged dogfood workflows may copy local-only bundle files into the Nix output.

review_notes.details: source-metadata.v1.json lists paths such as workflows/dogfood/scripts}/scherzo-review and workflows/dogfood}/execplan.yaml that are not repository paths and do not appear in changed-files.v1.json. Downstream consumers that trust source-metadata.changed_files could misreport or fail to resolve changed files for large rename diffs.
review_notes.suggested_action: Normalize or validate source-metadata changed paths during preparation, or ensure consumers use changed-files.v1.json as the authoritative changed-file list.
review_notes.summary: Retained source metadata includes malformed brace-derived paths.

review_notes.details: validation-status.v1.json reports status unknown because no test or build status was supplied to the dry-run entrypoint. I did not execute tests because this lane was instructed not to mutate files.
review_notes.suggested_action: Before merge, attach the actual SelfCI/unit/Nix validation result to the review artifacts or rerun the repository validation gate.
review_notes.summary: No validation status was supplied with the review artifacts.

review_notes.details: validation-status.v1.json says no test or build status was supplied to the review preparation step, so this lane could not rely on retained validation evidence.
review_notes.suggested_action: Attach the actual final validation commands and outcomes to review preparation artifacts for future lanes.
review_notes.summary: The retained validation status artifact does not report test/build results.

review_notes.details: Production code now injects `SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR`, and the probe fixture prints it, but `command_validator_uses_clean_environment_and_context_test` does not assert that the variable is present. A regression in the new environment propagation would therefore slip past the updated test.
review_notes.suggested_action: Assert the probe output contains the expected `SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR` value alongside the existing repo-root and validator-context checks.
review_notes.summary: Add a direct assertion for `SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR` in the command-validator env probe test

review_notes.details: `src/scherzo/workflow_bundle.gleam` and `src/scherzo/workflow_identity.gleam` now both implement the same bundle-dir resolution logic. I could not find a production caller of `workflow_bundle`, so this looks like a half-completed extraction rather than an intentional abstraction boundary.
review_notes.suggested_action: Keep one source of truth for bundle-dir resolution and remove or repurpose the duplicate module before more call sites drift.
review_notes.summary: Bundle-dir lookup logic is now duplicated across two Gleam modules.

review_notes.details: The same `bundle_dir=${SCHERZO_WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_DIR:-}; if [ -z "$bundle_dir" ]; then ...` prelude is copied into many commands across the dogfood workflows. That makes future quoting/path fixes expensive and easy to miss in one workflow while fixing another.
review_notes.suggested_action: Factor the bootstrap into a shared wrapper or helper command so bundle-path changes land in one place instead of dozens of inline shell strings.
review_notes.summary: Workflow YAML now repeats the same bundle bootstrap shell prologue in many steps.

review_notes.details: The retained brief/source metadata include entries such as workflows/dogfood}/... and workflows/dogfood/scripts}/... that are not present in diff.patch. This can mislead lane scoping and evidence targeting even though direct diff inspection was still possible.
review_notes.suggested_action: Fix rename/path normalization in review preparation so changed_file paths always match repository-relative paths from the patch.
review_notes.summary: Prepared artifact file lists contain brace-expanded bogus paths.
